name: Tortuga Bay
positioning: Tortuga Bay Hotel at Puntacana Resort: a beachfront villa enclave designed by Oscar de la Renta, set within the larger Puntacana Resort in the Dominican Republic
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach, pool and Jacuzzi reserved for a small enclave of guests
Families or groups booking multi-bedroom suites and villas
Golfers and tennis players who want resort courses close by

facts.text: Tortuga Bay opened in 2006 and was designed by the Dominican fashion designer Oscar de la Renta.
Oscar de la Renta drew on his Dominican roots in designing the villas.
Tortuga Bay sits in a private enclave within Puntacana Resort.
Rooms have coralline-stone bathrooms, a kitchenette and an oak walk-in closet.
The hotel has a pool, a Jacuzzi and a beach reserved exclusively for Tortuga Bay guests.
Tortuga Bay sits on 1,300 feet of private beach.
Bamboo restaurant pairs locally sourced food with Mediterranean influences, in a setting designed by Oscar de la Renta.
Tortuga Bay Lounge, beside Bamboo, is known for hand-rolled cigars and fine spirits.
Arriving guests get VIP service through immigration, luggage retrieval and customs at Punta Cana airport.
Round-trip private transportation between Punta Cana International Airport and the villa is included.
Puntacana Resort & Club has 45 holes of championship golf on Tom Fazio's Corales and P.B. Dye's La Cana courses.
The Oscar de la Renta Tennis Center has tennis, padel and pickleball courts plus a Technogym.

highlights.text: Bamboo's dining room has blush pink walls, a color handpicked by Oscar de la Renta.
La Yola serves Mediterranean cuisine and seafood and is designed to resemble a fishing boat in the Puntacana Resort Marina.
Every room is assigned an Embajador, a personal host.
Guests are given electric golf carts and bicycles to get around the resort.
Guests get included access to the Ojos Indigenas Ecological Reserve.

considerations.text: Junior Suites are on the second floor with a balcony; it is the Two Bedroom Suites that open directly onto the private beach.
Tortuga Bay is a private enclave inside the larger Puntacana Resort, and the golf courses and tennis center are resort facilities rather than part of the hotel itself.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing and limited villa inventory, so book ahead.
